title: Constructing an Agent Red-Team Challenge Dataset for Monitoring System Evaluation

original_idea.body:
# Constructing an Agent Red-Team Challenge Dataset for Monitoring System Evaluation

**Problem:** Monitoring system evaluation requires standardized, diverse challenge datasets. No such dataset exists specifically for agent monitoring evaluation.

**Direction:** Create a labeled dataset of 200+ agent trajectories spanning: benign tasks, overt attacks (prompt injection, goal hijacking, exfiltration), subtle attacks (living-off-the-land, gradual drift), and ambiguous cases. Include metadata: attack type, difficulty, kill-chain stage. Release publicly.

**Why it matters:** A public evaluation dataset enables comparable benchmarking across monitoring approaches — a fundamental infrastructure requirement for the field.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 attack test sets; benchmark development; monitoring evaluation tooling.
